page: Microsoft Azure L48as_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 AMD processor architecture configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of memory per core. The configuration operates without dedicated GPU acceleration.

A central hardware feature of the L48as_v5 is its integrated local disk subsystem, providing 11,520 GB of NVMe SSD direct-attached storage. In addition to high-capacity local solid-state disks, the virtual machine supports Azure Premium Storage tiers to handle diverse persistent and non-persistent data pipelines.

The deployment delivers high resource density by pairing 48 compute threads with multi-terabyte NVMe storage and substantial memory capacity. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of hardware accelerators and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which necessitates separate networking resources for inbound connectivity. The profile matches large relational database deployments, NoSQL data stores, distributed file systems, and real-time big data analytics engines.
